confirmed.name: Velankanni & Chennai
confirmed.blurb: A pilgrimage to the Basilica of Our Lady of Good Health at Velankanni, with time in Chennai on the way. The air ticket, hotel, visa and every transfer are in the price, so the group travels as one and nobody queues twice.
confirmed.alt: The white basilica at Velankanni against a blue sky

confirmed.name: Bhutan & the Golden Triangle
confirmed.blurb: Delhi, Agra and Jaipur first, then up into Bhutan's Himalayan valleys. Two countries and two visas on one escorted journey, with the Taj Mahal and the cliffside monasteries both on the list.
confirmed.alt: Tiger's Nest monastery on a cliff face in Bhutan

confirmed.name: Portugal
confirmed.blurb: Porto to Lisbon by road with an English-speaking guide, stopping at Coimbra, the walled town of Óbidos and the Templar castle at Tomar. Hotels, entrance fees and every transfer are included. Flights are quoted separately. Ask us about the Schengen visa.
confirmed.alt: Classic yellow tram climbing a hillside street in Lisbon
